## About
Universal Rehab Center, P.A. is a chiropractic office on Callaghan Rd in San Antonio. Patients come to us after car accidents, sports injuries, and the everyday strain of work and family life.
Dr. Regalado takes his time with each visit, listens to what is going on, and tailors care to your needs. Our bilingual office staff, including Mari and John, will greet you and help you feel at ease from the first day.
We are grateful for a 5-star Google rating from 57 reviews, and for the patients who keep coming back.

## Services
- Adjustments: Hands-on adjustments as part of a plan tailored to your body and your daily demands.
- Cupping, blading and taping: Additional methods Dr. Regalado may use alongside adjustments to help with long-standing issues.
- Care after a car accident: Patients are referred to us after car accidents. Dr. Regalado listens, recommends a treatment plan, and follows up along the way.

## FAQ
Q: I was in an accident. Can you help?
A: Yes. Patients come to us after accidents, and Dr. Regalado will listen and recommend a treatment plan for the pain you are dealing with.

Q: Can you help with paperwork for my employer?
A: One patient shared that Dr. Regalado made sure their paperwork for their employer was filled out and followed up afterward. Ask us at your visit.

Q: When are you open?
A: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday and Friday from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM, and Thursday from 9:00 AM to 2:00 PM. We are closed Saturday and Sunday.
